description: Perform pathway enrichment analysis for a gene list (Reactome over-representation). Requires at least 3 genes; the list is deduplicated (case-insensitive) before submission. Each pathway reports genes_overlap — the count of unique SUBMITTED genes Reactome matched there, resolved with one follow-up token lookup (Reactome's entity-level match count can exceed the gene count when one gene maps to multiple entities, e.g. a UniProt entry plus Ensembl gene/transcript). The reply also reports how many pathways Reactome found in total alongside the returned page. Typical completion is 15–45 s (the Reactome analysis takes 8–22 s per step across two sequential steps), with a worst case around 105 s including one retry per step; requires reachability of reactome.org, and clients whose request timeout is 60 s may need to raise it for large result follow-ups.

genes.description: List of HGNC gene symbols (minimum 3; duplicates and case variants are collapsed before submission)

limit.description: Maximum pathways to return (1-100; Reactome reports up to ~100)

name: gene_enrich
